issues.display_title: Issue #1243: Routing: doors narrower than their wall is thick seal the room ("has no door")
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From #1240 (video, Square One Mall V6 (Demo), Level 2). In Preview, Direction from Club Monaco to COS says "Club Monaco and COS have no door", although each room has a door on its wall.

Cause

buildGrid (src/lib/routing/pathfinder.ts) builds the walking grid. Since #1220 it draws only the parts of each wall that no door cuts. Each part is drawn as a capsule, so both ends are rounded, with a radius of half the wall's width.

At a doorway, the two rounded ends reach into the hole from both sides, each by half the wall's width. So a door narrower than the wall is thick is closed again in the grid.

  • On Square One the walls are 27.6 units thick, which is 1.38 m.
  • Since #1236 a new door is a real 0.9 m, which is 18 units.
  • In the live data, both doors are 18 units on a 27.6-unit wall.
  • Across each door the grid is open in the middle, but a blocked ring 7–10 units from the wall's centre line seals it.
  • The route planner reports both rooms as sealed.

Doors were 20 m wide before #1236, so this never showed up.

Impact (live data, 2026-10-14)

Level Doors Narrower than their wall Of which 0.9 m
Level 1 214 76 70
Level 2 268 236 227

None of these doors can be walked through, so Direction on Level 2 is effectively dead.

Scope

  1. Where a wall part ends at a door's hole, draw that end flat, so the hole keeps the door's full width.
  2. Keep the rounded ends at the wall's own ends and joints, so corners stay closed.
  3. Nothing changes for walls without doors.

Acceptance criteria

  • On Square One Mall V6, Level 2, Direction from Club Monaco to COS finds a route.
  • A 0.9 m door in a 27.6-unit wall lets a route through. Unit test.
  • A room without a door is still sealed, corners included. Unit test.
  • Routes through the wide doors that already worked are unchanged.

RESULT

video-1243-narrow-door-route.mp4

Released to main in cf681e8c (PR #1245 → development a5c71d39, release PR #1246). The Deploy succeeded.

Fix (commit 4b94365d, src/lib/routing/pathfinder.ts): drawWall takes roundA / roundB. A wall part's end at a door's hole is drawn flat, so the doorway keeps the door's full width. A wall's own ends stay round (t0 === 0 / t1 === 1), so small gaps where imported walls meet stay closed.

Tests: 3 new tests in route-thick-walls.test.ts:

  • a route goes through 0.9 m doors in 27.6-unit walls;
  • the doorway is open across the wall's whole thickness, and the wall beside it is still blocked;
  • a door-less room whose wall is split by a 20-unit gap stays sealed.

All 7 mutants are caught. pnpm test (3044), lint, tsc --noEmit and next build pass.

Checked:

development (before) fix production
COS → Club Monaco, Square One V6 L2 (Chrome, public /v/UkZnTKwv) "COS and Club Monaco have no door" Route found (4.7 s) Route found (5.2 s)
Club Monaco → each of the other 194 places on L2 (live data probe) 0 found 173 found
/v/b9PmEp8N FOX → Alo Yoga / Urban Planet → TCX found / Urban Planet sealed unchanged

Of the 21 places still without a route from Club Monaco:

  • 8 have no door, so Direction says "X has no door";
  • 13 (Cineplex, Whole Foods, LCBO, some restaurants) are not joined to Club Monaco's corridor in the data.

Found on the way: #1244 (Direction's place search doesn't rank names first).

Demo video: .playwright-mcp/demo/1243/video-1243-narrow-door-route.mp4.

issues.display_title: Issue #1249: Viewer Overview: buildings wear one slate roof instead of their rooms' colours
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From #1239. The PM's answers to #1247 were given in chat: a to every question.

Today

  • Zoomed in, rooms are drawn in their own colours. On Square One Mall V6, the anchors and the buildings around the mall are black.
  • Overview (below zoom 16.25) draws each building as a raised block in one slate colour (#8e97ab). So the colours switch as you zoom, and the mall wears a grey roof.

outdoorGeoJson (src/lib/map/geojson-utils.ts) builds the block from every area on the building's ground floor, raised to the building's full height. It never reads the areas' colours. The paint is OUTDOOR_SHELL_COLOR in layer-definitions.ts.

Scope (from #1247)

  1. Each part takes its area's colour (Q1 a), by the same rule as the zoomed-in map. One shared helper, so the two cannot drift apart:
    • a closed room uses its colour, or the closed-room default;
    • a Room, Hallway or standalone Area that has a colour uses it;
    • everything else uses the default floor colour (cream).
  2. Keep the raised block (Q2 a), at the building's full height. Standalone Areas stay low pads.
  3. Colours come from the ground floor (Q3 a), the floor the block is already built from.
  4. No logos in Overview (Q4 a).
  5. Nested areas are cut out of the area around them, as the zoomed-in map does. Otherwise two overlapping parts of different colours at the same height would flicker (z-fighting).
  6. A building whose ground floor has no areas keeps today's slate block.

Acceptance criteria

  • On Square One Mall V6, the Overview shows the anchors and the outside buildings black and the shops in their own colours, matching the zoomed-in map. There is no grey roof.
  • Zooming in and out no longer changes those buildings' colours.
  • A room inside another area is cut out of it in the Overview, so no two parts overlap. Unit test.
  • Unit tests cover each colour rule, the low pad and the no-area fallback.

RESULT

video-1249-overview-room-colours.mp4

Released to main in bb2d3e8e (PR #1250 → development 85b22665, release PR #1251). The Deploy succeeded.

Fix (commit 6d9a4128):

  • New areaFillColor(area) in src/lib/map/geojson-utils.ts, read by both the zoomed-in map and outdoorGeoJson:
    • a closed room uses its colour, or the closed-room default;
    • a coloured Room, Hallway or standalone Area uses its colour;
    • everything else gets the default cream.
  • Each Overview part carries that colour as shellColor, and is a MultiPolygon with nested areas cut out (areaHoles + cutHoles).
  • The block keeps the building's full height, standalone Areas stay low pads, and a ground floor with no areas keeps the slate block.
  • OUTDOOR_AREA_COLOR is removed.

Tests: 4 new tests in outdoorMode.test.ts; the #884 test was adjusted. All mutants are caught. pnpm test (3048), lint, tsc --noEmit and next build pass.

Checked, real Chrome on the public /v/UkZnTKwv (.playwright-mcp/demo/1249/check-overview.mjs):

Overview Zoomed in
development (before) one slate block black anchors and outside buildings
fix black anchors and outside buildings, white shops, coloured corridors the same black buildings
production the same as the fix the same black buildings

The corridors are pink in the Overview because Level 1's are. Zoomed in, the viewer opens Level 2, where they are grey. This follows #1247 Q3 a.

Demo video: .playwright-mcp/demo/1249/video-1249-overview-room-colours.mp4.

issues.display_title: Issue #1248: Editor: a failed save is never retried, and the message hides why ("Failed to save floorplan")
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From #1242 (video, Square One Mall V6 (Demo), about 06:37 UTC on 2026-10-14). The editor showed "Failed to save floorplan": the save server action returned {"ok":false,"error":"Failed to save floorplan"}.

What we know

  • The API answered with a failing status. The message means the API (POST /v1/floorplan/{id}) returned a status other than 2xx, 400 or 403. projectActionFailure (src/lib/projects/projectActionResult.ts) turns every other status into this one message, so the real status is lost. The floor_plan_save_failed analytics event does not carry it either.
  • Saving works today. A copy of V6 saved three times out of three: 2.42 MB, HTTP 200, 1.7–2.9 s each. The size limit is 20 MB, and the token lasts 30 days.
  • The edit was never saved. V6's live data is unchanged since 06:27, so what the reporter tried to save around 06:37 never reached the server.
  • The API was being deployed at the time. API-GO #221 went to development at 06:25 and #222 at 06:49, and merging to development deploys to production. A save during a restart fails this way. Not confirmed: that needs the API's logs from that window.

Why a short outage loses work

  • No automatic retry. saveNow in src/components/editor/EditorTopbar.tsx returns on a failed save without scheduling another try. The auto-save effect only runs again when the canvas changes, so nothing is retried until the user edits again or clicks Save. If the tab is closed first, the edits are lost.
  • The message doesn't say what happened. The API being unreachable, an expired session (401), a deleted project (404) and a too-large save (413) all show the same message.

Scope

  1. After a failed save, retry automatically while there are unsaved changes, waiting longer each time: about 5 s, 15 s, 30 s, then every 60 s. An edit or a Save click still saves at once.
  2. Make the message match the cause:
    • 5xx, 502/504 or a network error: "Can't reach the server. Retrying…";
    • 401: the session has expired, sign in again;
    • 404: this project no longer exists;
    • 413: the project is too large to save;
    • 400 and 403 keep the API's own message, as today.
  3. Add the HTTP status (or "network") to the floor_plan_save_failed event.

Acceptance criteria

  • With the API answering 502 for one save and then 200, the edit saves on its own, without another edit or a click. Unit test.
  • Retries stop once the save succeeds, or when there is nothing left to save.
  • 502/network, 401, 404 and 413 each show their own message. Unit test.
  • floor_plan_save_failed carries the status.

RESULT

video-1248-save-retry.mp4

Released to main in 1019cee7 (PR #1252 → development 9738cdec, release PR #1253). The Deploy succeeded.

Fix (commit 02f3b0bf):

  • src/lib/editor/saveRetry.ts (new):
    • describeSaveFailure(failure) returns { message, retry }:
      • an outage (no answer, a 5xx, no status): "Can't reach the server. Retrying…", retried;
      • 401, or "unauthorized": the session has expired. Not retried;
      • 404: the project no longer exists. Not retried;
      • 413: too large to save. Not retried;
      • 400 and 403: the API's own message. Not retried.
    • retryDelay(n) gives 5 s, 15 s, 30 s, then every 60 s.
  • EditorTopbar.saveNow: a retryable failure with unsaved changes schedules the next try on the auto-save timer. A new edit replaces it, and the waits start over after a success.
  • projectActionFailure attaches the HTTP status to every failure.
  • floor_plan_save_failed reports httpStatus ("network" when there was no answer).

Tests: 14 new tests across saveRetry, EditorTopbar.autosave, projectActionResult and editorEvents. The existing action tests were updated for status. All mutants are caught. pnpm test (3062), lint, tsc --noEmit and next build pass.

Checked, real Chrome with a scratch copy of Square One Mall V6 per run, all deleted (.playwright-mcp/demo/1248/check-retry.mjs). A door is added and the first save after it is cut off:

Message after the cut 12 s later Doors on the server
development (before) "Failed to save project" still the error 482 → 482
fix "Can't reach the server. Retrying…" "Saved just now" 482 → 483
production "Can't reach the server. Retrying…" "Saved just now" 482 → 483

Demo video: .playwright-mcp/demo/1248/video-1248-save-retry.mp4.

issues.display_title: Issue #1241: Editor: door/window Size slider stops at 3 m, too short for mall shopfronts
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Follow-up to #1236. Since #1236 the door/window Size slider reads and sets real metres, but its range is still 0.3–3 m (OPENING_W_MIN_M / OPENING_W_MAX_M in src/lib/floorplanEditor/editor/constants.ts). Mall shopfront openings are much wider than that.

Data

On Square One Mall V6 (Demo), these are the openings that came with the import. The 0.9 m doors added since #1236 are not counted.

Level Openings ≤ 3 m 3–6 m 6–10 m 10–20 m > 20 m
Level 1 144 43 63 22 14 2
Level 2 41 26 4 7 3 1

About 90 % are 10 m or narrower.

Today

  • Selecting a 6 m shopfront shows 6.00 m in the readout, but the slider thumb sits at its 3 m end.
  • Moving the slider at all shrinks the opening to 3 m or less.
  • No opening can be widened past 3 m with the slider.

Scope

  1. Raise the slider's maximum to 10 m.
  2. Keep the 0.3 m minimum and the 0.1 m step.
  3. New doors stay 0.9 m and new windows 1.2 m.

Acceptance criteria

  • On Square One Mall V6, a selected 6 m shopfront door shows the slider thumb at 6 m, not at the end.
  • Moving the slider right widens that door, up to 10 m.
  • The slider still goes down to 0.3 m in 0.1 m steps.
  • A new door is still 0.9 m.

RESULT

video-1241-shopfront-slider.mp4

Released to main in fbdb5b2d (PR #1254 → development da47ce5b, release PR #1256 together with #1244). The Deploy succeeded.

Fix (commit c2b9c0ac): OPENING_W_MAX_M goes from 3 to 10 in src/lib/floorplanEditor/editor/constants.ts. The slider's max and the clamp in setSelectedOpeningWidth both read it. The 0.3 m minimum, the 0.1 m step and the sizes of new doors (0.9 m) and windows (1.2 m) are unchanged. A stale comment about the removed 50 m span is fixed.

Tests: 2 new tests in opening-width.test.ts: 6 m, 10 m, the clamp at 12 m and the clamp at 0.1 m. The mutant is caught. pnpm test, lint, tsc --noEmit and next build pass.

Checked, real Chrome on a scratch copy of Square One Mall V6 per run, all deleted (.playwright-mcp/demo/1241/check-slider.mjs). The test selects imported door 42 on Level 1, which is 6 m wide, then presses End:

Readout Slider After End
development (before) 6.00 m 3 of max 3 (at its end) unchanged: it cannot widen
fix 6.00 m 6 of max 10 10.00 m
production 6.00 m 6 of max 10 10.00 m

Known, not new: the slider does not limit an opening to its wall's length, so 10 m can run past the end of a shorter wall.

Demo video: .playwright-mcp/demo/1241/video-1241-shopfront-slider.mp4.

issues.display_title: Issue #1244: Preview search: a place named exactly what you type can be missing from Direction's results (no ranking, first 10)
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Found while checking #1240. On Square One Mall V6 (/v/UkZnTKwv), typing "COS" in Direction's origin or destination field never lists the store COS. The ten results are Spirit Halloween, LCBO, Toothworks, Miniso and others, whose descriptions contain "cos" ("costumes", "cosmetics"…). The reporter of #1240 had to find COS on the map instead.

Cause

  • Direction, origin and destination (src/components/editor/preview/DirectionAreaAutocomplete.tsx, lines 44–54 and 103): a place matches when the query is in its title, its level name or its description. The matches keep the list's order (Level 1 first), with no ranking, and only the first 10 are shown. A place whose name is the query can fall past the cut.
  • Search Area (matchTargets in src/components/editor/preview/AreaAutocomplete.tsx, used by SearchAreaPanel.tsx): the same match with no ranking, and no cap. "COS" is result 10 of 19 there.

Scope

  1. Rank matches before showing them, best first:
    1. the name equals the query;
    2. the name starts with the query;
    3. a word in the name starts with the query;
    4. the name contains the query;
    5. a search tag matches;
    6. the description or the level name matches.
  2. Within a rank, keep today's order.
  3. Use the same ranking in Direction's fields and in Search Area.
  4. Keep Direction's 10-result cap. With the ranking, it no longer hides an exact name.

Acceptance criteria

  • On Square One Mall V6, typing "COS" in Direction's origin or destination shows COS first.
  • In Search Area, "COS" shows COS first.
  • Typing a word that appears only in a description still finds that place.
  • Unit tests cover the ranking.

RESULT

video-1244-search-ranking.mp4

Released to main in fbdb5b2d (PR #1255 → development b8c9ad42, release PR #1256 together with #1241). The Deploy succeeded.

Fix (commit eb949256):

  • New src/lib/preview/searchRank.ts:
    • searchRank ranks a match: exact name 0, name start 1, a word's start 2, anywhere in the name 3, search tag 4, description or level 5;
    • rankMatches keeps the matches best first, with a stable sort.
  • Search Area's matchTargets and Direction's DirectionAreaAutocomplete both rank with it. Direction ranks before its 10-row cap, and now also matches search tags.

Tests: 7 new tests across searchRank, AreaAutocomplete and DirectionAreaAutocomplete. All mutants are caught except one equivalent mutant: the empty-query early return. pnpm test, lint, tsc --noEmit and next build pass.

Checked, real Chrome on the public /v/UkZnTKwv (.playwright-mcp/demo/1244/check-search.mjs), typing "COS":

Direction Search Area
development (before) Spirit Halloween, LCBO, Toothworks… (no COS) Spirit Halloween, LCBO…
fix COS, MAC Cosmetics, Lacoste, Spirit Halloween COS first
production COS first COS first

Demo video: .playwright-mcp/demo/1244/video-1244-search-ranking.mp4.
